subject: Mathematics
title: Probability
summary: Event ki probability = favourable outcomes / kul equally likely outcomes. Addition rule 'ya' (or) sambhaalta hai, multiplication rule 'aur' (and).
Conditional probability P(A|B) = P(A ∩ B)/P(B) se total probability theorem aur Bayes' theorem milte hain — JEE favourite.

Random variable outcomes ko numbers deta hai; uske distribution ka mean (expectation) aur variance hota hai. Binomial distribution n independent trials ko success probability p ke saath model karta hai.

formulas.name: Addition rule
formulas.formula: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B);  mutually exclusive: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B)

formulas.name: Multiplication rule and independence
formulas.formula: P(A ∩ B) = P(A)P(B|A);  independent ⇔ P(A ∩ B) = P(A)P(B)
formulas.mistake: Mutually exclusive events (non-zero probabilities ke saath) kabhi independent nahi hote — dono ko confuse mat karo.

formulas.name: Total probability
formulas.formula: P(A) = Σ P(Eᵢ)P(A|Eᵢ)  for a partition E₁, …, Eₙ

formulas.name: Bayes' theorem
formulas.when: Reverse probability — result kis cause se aaya.

formulas.name: Random variable
formulas.formula: mean μ = E(X) = Σ xᵢpᵢ;  variance σ² = Σ xᵢ²pᵢ − μ²

formulas.name: Binomial distribution
formulas.formula: P(X = r) = C(n, r) pʳ qⁿ⁻ʳ (q = 1 − p);  mean np;  variance npq

formulas.name: Common sample spaces
formulas.formula: two dice: 36 outcomes;  three coins: 8;  a pack: 52 cards (4 suits × 13)

formulas.name: Odds
formulas.formula: odds in favour of A = P(A) : P(A′)

examples.title: Bayes
examples.problem: Bag I mein 3 red, 2 black; bag II mein 2 red, 3 black. Random bag chuna aur red ball nikli. P(bag I se aayi)?

examples.title: Binomial
examples.problem: Ek coin 4 baar uchhaala. P(theek 2 heads)?

examples.title: Kam se kam ek six
examples.problem: Die ke 3 throws mein kam se kam ek six ki probability?

examples.title: Expectation
examples.problem: Fair die roll ki expected value?

topics.title: Events
topics.explain: Sample space S, events uske subsets; mutually exclusive (koi common outcome nahi), exhaustive (union = S), independent (ek doosre ko affect nahi karta), complementary.

topics.title: Using P&C
topics.explain: Cards, committees ya arrangements ke liye favourable aur total cases combinations se gino. Jaise P(2 cards mein 2 aces) = ⁴C₂/⁵²C₂ = 1/221.

topics.title: Independent vs mutually exclusive
topics.explain: Independent: P(A ∩ B) = P(A)P(B). Mutually exclusive: P(A ∩ B) = 0. A aur B independent hon to A′ aur B, A aur B′, A′ aur B′ bhi independent.

topics.title: Geometric probability
topics.explain: Jab outcomes kisi region ke points hon, probability = favourable length/area/volume ÷ total.

topics.title: Problems on 'without replacement'
topics.explain: Har draw ke baad probabilities badalti hain; conditional probabilities ya seedhe combinations use karo.

topics.title: Bayes' strategy
topics.explain: Causes (bags, machines, log) ko prior probabilities ke saath likho, har ek ke liye P(result | cause) nikalo, result ki total probability nikalo, phir chahiye wale term ko total se divide karo.

ratta: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B).
Bayes = one path ÷ total of all paths.
